layout.summaryRow: One row; narrow screens scroll only the summary area
layout.graphPeriod: Current Korean calendar month and the previous two months

data.scope: Verified current owner's records only, including for administrators
data.inventoryCapital: Unsold rows summed with the existing inventoryInvestmentOf: purchase price plus costs and daily interest, excluding income tax
data.realizedMargin: Completed rows use totals(buy, salePrice(car), normalizeCosts(car)).margin
data.purchaseCounts: All own rows with a real purchaseAt date, including vehicles already sold
data.saleCountsAndMargin: Completed own rows with a real soldAt date
data.yearMargin: Current year through the reporting month; future reporting months excluded
data.totalInvestment: Inventory capital plus cash; unavailable until an actual personal cash balance is connected
data.currency: KRW integer amounts, displayed in won with thousands separators

privacy.financeGate: Existing personal finance-lock policy and password verification protect dashboard entry
privacy.grantScope: Current company, user and role scope key
privacy.staleCallbacks: Rejected by current scope and key checks
privacy.refresh: Data events plus a metadata-only scope/day check; recalculations include Korean midnight and month rollover

checks: Read-only own scope, administrator own-only data and accountant denial
Daily interest, costs and income-tax rules agree with the existing calculations
Negative-profit chart uses a correct zero baseline
All seven summary cards stay in one row without page overflow
Compact graph and workflow cards, pointer and keyboard help, stable hovering points
Existing vehicle details and buy, sell and finance navigation
Dashboard wrong/right password, per-entry relock and original finance destination
Company-bound grants, loading/auth invalidation and stale callbacks
Korean day and month rollover refresh amounts and reporting periods
Existing transient-auth isolation, preference failures, late acknowledgements and history protection
No source dataset writes, external fixture requests or unexpected browser errors
